overview: Based on the published agenda, the Riverside Fire District Board was scheduled to hold a regular meeting on November 18, 2026, to review previous meeting minutes and consider a closed session to discuss employee performance evaluation data for the Fire Chief. The meeting was set to take place at Rothschild Village Hall.

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to review and act upon the minutes from the previous regular meeting held on October 29, 2026.

discussions.item: Closed Session - Fire Chief Performance Evaluation
discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to consider a motion to adjourn to closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes Section 19.85 (1)(c) to discuss employee performance evaluation data feedback for the Riverside Fire District Fire Chief. Following the closed session, the Board was expected to reconvene in open session to take action on items discussed.
